Our legal archive team has a folder of mixed-format legacy documents that need to be digitized for our compliance system. The documents are located in /workspace and include old Word contracts (.doc), modern Word briefs (.docx), a PDF financial summary, and a PowerPoint board presentation — six documents in total (see /workspace/task_spec.json for the list).

Please convert ALL of them to Markdown format, then produce a single audit manifest file named `conversion_manifest.json` (place it anywhere in /workspace). The manifest must record, for each document: whether the conversion succeeded or failed, and key text statistics (at minimum: line count, word count, and character count).

Note that some of the legacy .doc files contain Chinese text — make sure those are handled correctly. The tools you need are already on the system; check /root/.openclaw/workspace/office-to-md-v2/ for what's available.
